overview: The uploaded textbook chapter 'The Frog' develops reading, language, interpretation, vocabulary and communication through 'The Frog'.
source_grounded_key_points: 5 The Frog Let us Recite I sit in ponds and in the rain, Or hop about in a muddy drain.
As a tadpole, I swim with cheer, A tiny fish-like thing, so clear!
I flick my tongue to catch my food, It works so fast—now that’s quite good!
I live on land and water too, In places damp with drops of dew.
My colours match the plants and trees, I hide so well in grass and leaves!
But snakes are near, I must beware, Or else they’ll catch me unaware!
I croak my songs, they sound so loud, Yet in my pond, I feel so proud.
I hop around, I jump so high, Up I go into the sky!
